name: GetAttachmentSummary
label: Get Salesforce Attachment Summary
description: Retrieves summary information about attachments linked to a parent record, such as the total count.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ParentId
fields.label: Parent ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the parent record (e.g., Account, Contact) to summarize attachments for.

fields.name: SummaryData
fields.label: Summary Data
fields.description: The summary data as a JSON string (e.g., count of attachments).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
